name: Accordion Pattern (Sections With Show/Hide Functionality)
keyboard: Enter/Space toggles the focused heading button. Tab visits each header and visible panel control.
aria: Heading containing a button; aria-expanded and aria-controls. Optional region for a panel; name it from its heading.
javascript: Toggle panels and update expanded state. Native details/summary is an alternative for simple disclosure.
screenReader: Header name and expanded/collapsed state; hidden panel content is excluded.

name: Alert Pattern
keyboard: No special keys and no automatic focus move.
aria: role=alert for urgent dynamic text. Do not put routine updates in alerts.
javascript: Insert or change alert text when the event happens; avoid repeated announcements.
screenReader: Urgent update announced while the user stays at their current location.

name: Alert and Message Dialogs Pattern
keyboard: Focus enters the dialog. Tab/Shift+Tab stay inside it. Escape closes where appropriate; restore focus on exit.
aria: role=alertdialog; aria-modal=true; accessible name and aria-describedby for the message.
javascript: Make background inert, manage opening/closing and focus, and provide response buttons.
screenReader: Dialog name, urgent message and available response controls.

name: Breadcrumb Pattern
keyboard: Tab between links; Enter follows a link. No custom arrow navigation.
aria: Labelled nav with an ordered list; aria-current=page on the current page link.
javascript: None for normal links. Update current page when navigation changes.
screenReader: Navigation landmark, ordered ancestry and current-page indication.

name: Button Pattern
keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter/Space activates.
aria: Prefer button. Toggle buttons use aria-pressed; unavailable buttons use disabled or carefully managed aria-disabled.
javascript: Perform the action and manage focus if it opens/closes another context.
screenReader: Name, button role and pressed/disabled state. Keep toggle names stable.

name: Carousel (Slide Show or Image Rotator) Pattern

examples.name: Auto-Rotating Image Carousel with Buttons for Slide Control:
Auto-Rotating Image Carousel with Tabs for Slide Control:

keyboard: Tab through controls; Enter/Space operates buttons. Stop rotation on focus and hover; restart only by explicit request.
aria: Labelled region/group with aria-roledescription=carousel; labelled slides. Tabbed variants also follow the tabs pattern.
javascript: Previous/next, pause/resume and slide visibility; hidden slides must not retain focusable controls.
screenReader: Carousel and slide identity, rotation control, and manual slide changes without distracting automatic announcements.

name: Checkbox Pattern
keyboard: Tab focuses; Space toggles.
aria: Prefer input type=checkbox and label. Custom checkbox needs aria-checked; mixed represents partial selection.
javascript: Native toggling needs no script. Script group aggregation or custom controls.
screenReader: Name and checked, unchecked or mixed state.

name: Combobox Pattern

examples.name: Editable Combobox with Both List and Inline Autocomplete

keyboard: Tab reaches the combobox. Down Arrow enters suggestions; Enter accepts; Escape dismisses. Preserve normal text-editing keys. Popup variants have additional keys.
aria: role=combobox; label; aria-expanded and aria-controls. aria-autocomplete for editable suggestions; aria-activedescendant when input retains focus.
javascript: Manage popup, active option, selection, filtering and Escape. Use the exact keyboard model for the chosen popup type.
screenReader: Name, editable/select-only role, expanded state, active suggestion and selected value.

name: Dialog (Modal) Pattern
keyboard: Move focus inside on opening; Tab/Shift+Tab wrap inside; Escape closes; restore focus to opener or a logical successor.
aria: Prefer dialog opened with showModal. Give an accessible name. Custom modal: role=dialog and aria-modal=true.
javascript: Open/close and set suitable initial focus; background is inert. Include a visible close button.
screenReader: Dialog name and contents; background is not reachable while modal. Describe only simple dialog messages.

name: Disclosure (Show/Hide) Pattern

examples.name: Disclosure (Show/Hide) of Answers to Frequently Asked Questions
Disclosure (Show/Hide) Navigation Menu with Top-Level Links

keyboard: Enter/Space on the control toggles visibility. Tab visits visible controls.
aria: Prefer details/summary; custom button uses aria-expanded and optionally aria-controls.
javascript: Native details works without script. Custom version toggles hidden and expanded together.
screenReader: Control name and expanded/collapsed state; only shown content is navigable.

name: Feed Pattern
keyboard: Recommended: Page Down/Up moves between articles; Ctrl+End/Home exits after/before the feed. Document any custom commands.
aria: Named feed; labelled article items with aria-posinset and aria-setsize; aria-busy during updates.
javascript: Coordinate article focus with loading/removal; preserve reading position and provide an alternative to infinite scrolling.
screenReader: Article identity and position; newly loaded content is available without unexpected focus movement.

name: Grid (Interactive Tabular Data and Layout Containers) Pattern
keyboard: Arrow keys navigate cells. Home/End and Ctrl+Home/End navigate rows/grid. Tab enters/exits. Editing has a documented enter/exit model.
aria: grid, row, gridcell/rowheader/columnheader; label. aria-selected only when selection exists; indices/counts for virtualized data.
javascript: Manage one Tab stop, cell focus, optional editing and selection. Use a native table for static data.
screenReader: Grid identity, row/column relationships, cell content and any selected/editing state.

name: Landmarks Pattern
keyboard: Use screen-reader landmark commands; interactive descendants use normal Tab order.
aria: Prefer main, nav, header, footer, aside. Give distinct names to repeated landmarks; avoid unnecessary regions.
javascript: None. Maintain semantic structure when content changes.
screenReader: Page regions available in the screen reader landmark list with useful names.

name: Link Pattern
keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter follows. Native links support browser context menus and opening in another tab.
aria: Prefer a with href and meaningful text; aria-current when appropriate.
javascript: None for ordinary navigation. Custom role=link alone provides no navigation behavior.
screenReader: Link name, destination context and current-page state when applicable.

name: Listbox Pattern
keyboard: Up/Down moves among vertical options. Home/End and type-ahead are recommended for longer lists. Space can toggle multi-selection; document the selection model.
aria: listbox with named options and aria-selected (or consistent aria-checked model); aria-multiselectable for multiple choice.
javascript: Manage active option and selection using roving tabindex or aria-activedescendant. Options should not contain interactive controls.
screenReader: Listbox name, active option, position and selection state.

name: Menu and Menubar Pattern
keyboard: Arrow keys move between items and submenus; Enter activates; Escape closes and returns focus. Tab exits rather than visiting each item.
aria: menu/menubar with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox or menuitemradio. Submenu triggers expose aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.
javascript: Manage focus, submenus, wrapping and dismissal. Ordinary site navigation should remain native links.
screenReader: Menu identity, item name, submenu availability and checked/disabled states.

name: Menu Button Pattern

examples.name: Action Menu Button Example Using aria-activedescendant
Action Menu Button Example Using element.focus()

keyboard: Enter/Space opens menu and focuses its first item. Optional Up/Down opens at last/first. Use menu keys inside.
aria: button with aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded; menu and menuitem descendants.
javascript: Open/close menu, manage item focus and restore focus to button on Escape.
screenReader: Button name, menu availability, expanded state and focused menu item.

name: Meter Pattern
keyboard: No special keyboard interaction; value is read, not adjusted.
aria: Prefer meter. Custom meter needs accessible name, aria-valuenow/min/max; aria-valuetext for useful units.
javascript: Update displayed value and semantics together if data changes.
screenReader: Named measurement, current value and range/units.

name: Radio Group Pattern

examples.name: Radio Group Example Using Roving tabindex

keyboard: Tab enters/exits group. Outside toolbars, arrows wrap and select; Space selects. Toolbar radio groups use a different arrow/selection model.
aria: Prefer same-name radio inputs with fieldset/legend. Custom radiogroup and radio need names and aria-checked.
javascript: Native groups work without script. Custom groups manage focus and mutually exclusive selection.
screenReader: Group label, option name, checked state and position.

name: Slider Pattern
keyboard: Right/Up increases; Left/Down decreases. Home/End reaches bounds. Optional Page Up/Down uses larger steps.
aria: Prefer input type=range with label; custom slider uses aria-valuenow/min/max and optional aria-valuetext/orientation.
javascript: Native range supplies keys. Custom slider handles keys and pointer input, bounds and value updates.
screenReader: Slider name, value with useful units, limits and orientation.

name: Slider (Multi-Thumb) Pattern
keyboard: Each thumb is a separate Tab stop with slider keys; keep Tab order stable when values cross.
aria: Each thumb is a named slider with its own value and limits; update dependent limits if thumbs constrain one another.
javascript: Manage thumb focus, keyboard/pointer changes and value dependencies without changing Tab order.
screenReader: Distinct thumb names (such as minimum/maximum) and each value/range.

name: Spinbutton Pattern
keyboard: Up/Down changes value; Home/End reaches defined bounds. Preserve normal text editing. Optional Page Up/Down changes larger steps.
aria: Prefer input type=number with label. Custom spinbutton needs aria-valuenow/min/max; aria-valuetext for nonnumeric meaning.
javascript: Validate editable values; implement custom stepping and bounds; communicate invalid input.
screenReader: Control name, current value, allowed range and invalid state where relevant.

name: Switch Pattern

examples.name: Switch Example Using HTML Checkbox Input

keyboard: Tab focuses; Space toggles; Enter is optional.
aria: Labelled switch with aria-checked=true/false; a checkbox with role=switch uses native checked. Name must remain constant.
javascript: Update on/off value and state together. Native checkbox toggles without script.
screenReader: Stable name, switch role and on/off state.

name: Table Pattern
keyboard: No custom keyboard model. Use screen-reader table commands and normal Tab for controls in cells.
aria: Prefer table, caption, th and scope. Custom table uses row/cell/header roles and indices for partial data.
javascript: None for a static table. Sorting must update content and aria-sort on the sorted header.
screenReader: Caption, dimensions and associated row/column headers while navigating cells.

name: Tabs Pattern
keyboard: Tab enters on active tab. Left/Right moves horizontal tabs; Up/Down for vertical. Enter/Space selects in manual mode. Home/End optional.
aria: Named tablist; tabs with aria-selected and aria-controls; tabpanels named by their tabs. Inactive tabs tabindex=-1.
javascript: Manage roving focus and panel visibility. Automatic activation only when panels appear without latency.
screenReader: Tab name, position, selected state and correctly associated visible panel.

name: Toolbar Pattern
keyboard: One Tab entry; Left/Right navigates horizontal controls, Up/Down vertical. Home/End optional. Inner controls retain relevant activation keys.
aria: Named toolbar; aria-orientation for vertical layouts. Controls retain their native roles and states.
javascript: Manage roving focus and remember last control if useful. Avoid competing arrow-key widgets without a clear model.
screenReader: Toolbar name plus each control name and state.

name: Tooltip Pattern
keyboard: Appears on focus as well as hover; Escape dismisses. Focus remains on trigger.
aria: role=tooltip; trigger references text using aria-describedby. Tooltip has no interactive descendants.
javascript: Show on focus/hover; dismiss on Escape, blur or pointer exit; remain visible while pointer is over tooltip.
screenReader: Supplementary description for the trigger; essential instructions must be available without hover.

name: Tree View Pattern

examples.name: File Directory Treeview Example Using Computed Properties
File Directory Treeview Example Using Declared Properties

keyboard: Right expands or enters children; Left collapses or moves to parent. Up/Down visits visible nodes; Home/End and type-ahead navigate.
aria: Named tree with treeitem and nested group; aria-expanded for parents; selected/checked state only when implemented.
javascript: Manage visible-node focus, expansion and selection. Keep focus and selection distinct in multi-select trees.
screenReader: Node name, hierarchy level, position and expanded/selected state.

name: Treegrid Pattern
keyboard: Arrow keys navigate hierarchy and cells; Right/Left expands/collapses at appropriate row/first cell. Enter acts; Tab can visit controls in the focused row.
aria: Named treegrid with row/gridcell/header roles; aria-expanded on parent rows or first cells; hierarchy and indices for partial data.
javascript: Coordinate hierarchical rows, cell/row focus, expansion, editing and selection using the documented variant.
screenReader: Cell/header relationships, hierarchy level, expanded and selected states.

name: Window Splitter Pattern
keyboard: Arrows move the separator along its axis. Enter collapses/restores the primary pane. Home/End and F6 pane cycling are optional.
aria: Focusable separator; aria-orientation, aria-valuenow/min/max, aria-controls for primary pane; name from that pane.
javascript: Resize panes, update value, support keyboard and pointer input, and preserve usable bounds. APG example work is incomplete.
screenReader: Splitter name, orientation and primary-pane size/value.
